You will work on design, development, and deployment of the Neuron Tools. You will contribute to our cluster observability platform for Trainium accelerators — building real-time telemetry collection, device health tracking, cross-node error correlation, and health trend visualization at fleet scale. This system gives customers full visibility into large-scale clusters, enabling them to detect and resolve issues before they impact workloads. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Transactional Services (Database & Distributed Systems)
jobs.description: As AWS and Amazon.com continue to grow, to serve more customers, and to support more products, the foundational technologies of AWS also need to evolve and support new use cases and larger scale than ever before. The AWS Transactional Services team is building distributed systems and database technologies that offer innovative solutions to this growth. Our customers are a range of AWS services, each of them looking for technology solutions that help them to meet their customer needs. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer to work on an in-house distributed database system the serves some of the most demanding needs of AWS services. This system pioneered database concepts that are now considered state-of-the-art innovations within the field. In this role you will continue to innovate for Amazon and support AWS’ ever-increasing needs and scale. Your responsibilities will include designing and developing novel, distributed, highly available, and scalable database technologies. You will be working with a team of highly passionate and knowledgeable SDEs, participating in design, code reviews, and engaging in problem-solving. You will engage with customers to understand their needs and support them operationally. While maintaining current technical knowledge to support rapidly changing technology, you will look out for new technologies and work with the team to adapt and improvise. Candidates will have the opportunity to work with senior engineers who have built deep knowledge in distributed systems and database technologies. Key job responsibilities Our engineers collaborate across diverse teams, projects, and environments to have a firsthand impact on our global customer base. You’ll bring a passion for innovation, data, search, analytics, and distributed systems. You’ll also: - Solve challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, at every layer of the stack. - Design, implement, test, deploy and maintain innovative software solutions to transform service performance, durability, cost, and security. - Build high-quality, highly available, always-on products. - Research implementations that deliver the best possible experiences for customers. A day in the life As you design and code solutions to help our team drive efficiencies in software architecture, you’ll create metrics, implement automation and other improvements, and resolve the root cause of software defects. You’ll also: - Build high-impact solutions to deliver to our large customer base. - Participate in design discussions, code review, and communicate with internal and external stakeholders. - Work cross-functionally to help drive business decisions with your technical input. - Work in a startup-like development environment, where you’re always working on the most important stuff. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. Are you passionate about building software that launches satellites into orbit? Join our team where your code directly enables successful satellite launches across production facilities and launch sites worldwide. We're looking for a skilled engineer to develop and maintain the software and server host systems that control and monitor Umbilical Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) critical to satellite testing, manufacturing, and launch operations. Our EGSE racks interface with a satellite's flight computer via the umbilical harness for power operations and network connectivity. Your work will span the full stack: designing and deploying EGSE software that manages hardware and interacts with flight software, configuring and managing host computers and building tooling for users and stakeholders. This role offers the unique opportunity to see the tangible impact of your software engineering work as satellites you helped test successfully reach space. If you're excited about combining low-level systems programming with real-time operational challenges, troubleshooting critical ground systems, and delivering self-service platforms that manufacturing and launch teams depend on every day, this is the role for you. Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement robust software features for EGSE core systems, ensuring high quality through thorough code reviews and operational excellence - Collaborate with cross-functional teams at manufacturing facilities and launch sites to troubleshoot urgent technical issues and deliver solutions that improve operational productivity - Participate actively in the full software development lifecycle, including scoping requirements, designing scalable solutions, coding, testing, deploying, and maintaining software systems - Drive continuous improvement by identifying root causes of operational issues and implementing permanent fixes that enhance system reliability and performance - Mentor team members through constructive code reviews and knowledge-sharing, documenting software architecture, operations, and testing practices to enable effective team collaboration A day in the life You'll start your day reviewing sprint progress and prioritizing features for EGSE host systems that support multiple satellite testing activities. Throughout the day, you'll implement new features, collaborate with teams at launch sites to troubleshoot urgent issues, and conduct code reviews that elevate your team's engineering practices. You'll balance designing robust solutions with responding to real-time operational needs from manufacturing teams. Your work directly enables satellites to launch successfully, and you'll see the tangible impact of your software across production facilities and launch sites. About the team Our team operates in an agile environment, running sprints to incrementally develop new features while maintaining rapid response capabilities for critical issues discovered at customer sites. We balance innovation with reliability, ensuring that our software meets the customer requirements. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering culture that values both technical excellence and responsiveness to operational needs. We're committed to continuous learning and knowledge-sharing, with experienced engineers who provide mentorship through code reviews and collaborative problem-solving. jobs.title: Software Engineer Apps 4
jobs.description: The group you’ll be a part of The Semiverse Solutions team develops physics-based modeling and simulation capabilities to accelerate semiconductor equipment and process development. Our work spans reactor-scale plasma modeling and feature-scale process modeling, bringing together plasma physics, chemistry, transport, and surface interactions to understand complex process behavior. The team works across disciplines to develop and apply predictive models that provide engineering insight and enable faster, more informed technology development. The impact you’ll make As a Software Application Engineer at Lam, you will develop and apply advanced physics-based modeling and simulation capabilities for semiconductor equipment and process applications. You will use computational models, simulation data, and physical understanding to investigate complex process behavior and provide insights that accelerate technology development. In this role, you will contribute to reactor-scale and feature-scale modeling capabilities, work closely with cross-functional engineering teams, and help connect simulation predictions with experimental observations. Your work will improve our understanding of semiconductor processes and enable more effective use of modeling and simulation in engineering decision-making. What you’ll do Develop and apply reactor-scale plasma and feature-scale process models to understand complex process behavior. Model physical and chemical phenomena including plasma behavior, gas-phase chemistry, transport, and surface interactions. Develop, calibrate, and validate models using simulation and experimental data. Design and execute computational studies to understand process sensitivities and identify underlying physical mechanisms. Analyze simulation results and translate them into actionable engineering insights. Develop computational workflows and tools for simulation setup, automation, data analysis, and visualization. Collaborate with process engineers, experimental teams, software developers, and modeling experts to improve simulation capabilities and their application. Communicate modeling results, physical interpretation, and recommendations to technical stakeholders. Contribute to the development and adoption of modeling and simulation methodologies across semiconductor applications. Who we’re looking for Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, or a related technical field with 8+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 6+ years of experience; or PhD with 3+ years of experience; or equivalent experience. Experience with physics-based modeling, scientific computing, engineering simulation, or data analysis. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect modeling and simulation results to underlying physical phenomena. Experience developing or applying computational models to complex engineering problems. Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical results to a broad range of stakeholders. Preferred qualifications Advanced degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Applied Physics, or a related technical discipline. Experience with low-temperature plasma physics, plasma chemistry, or semiconductor plasma processing . Experience with reactor-scale plasma modeling and/or feature-scale process modeling . Understanding of gas-phase chemistry, surface reaction mechanisms, transport phenomena, and plasma-surface interactions. Experience developing, calibrating, or validating physics-based models against experimental data. Experience with simulation DOE, sensitivity analysis, or parameter optimization. Proficiency in Python/ AI agentic workflows for scientific computing, simulation automation, data analysis, and visualization. Experience with multiphysics or scientific simulation software. Experience working across modeling, software, process, and experimental engineering teams. Semiconductor equipment or process experience is preferred. Our commitment We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results. Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees. Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time. Our Perks and Benefits At Lam, our people make amazing things possible. That’s why we invest in you throughout the phases of your life with a comprehensive set of outstanding benefits.
